audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was given to Ziggs at 2/10 while whys[4] says Ornn owns the all-in there; Level 3 was Ziggs while whys[2] calls it even footing; first item was Skill while whys[5] describes Ornn walking through the bombs.
audit.why: Three rows contradict their own why text. The packet chart (Ziggs, Ziggs, Skill, Skill, Ornn, Ornn, Ziggs) matches the prose, and a 50.29% win rate does not support Ziggs owning five of seven stages.
audit.corrected: Row 2 to Skill, rows 4 and 5 to Ornn in both layers, with Level 6 raised from 2/10 to 7/10.

audit.why: Four spikes: Ziggs early, Ornn at 3 with the pillar, Ornn at 6, Ziggs on full artillery build.

audit.whatIsWrong: Satchel Charge was described vaguely as 'knockback + self-peel escape' with no cooldown, and R was called a 'double knock-up'.
audit.why: Satchel Charge (W, 20/18/16/14/12s, 1000 range) knocks you away and launches Ziggs himself clear, and its damage is percent max health — so armour stacking does not blunt it. Bouncing Bomb (Q) is 6/5.5/5/4.5/4s at 850. Hexplosive Minefield (E) is a flat 16s slowing zone at 900. Mega Inferno Bomb is 120/95/70s from 5000 range. Short Fuse is an auto-attack reset, so the windup is the tell. Ornn's R is one pass that slows and applies Brittle, with the knock-up on the recast.
audit.corrected: Added real cooldowns, the max-health damage, the auto-reset tell, and corrected the R description.

audit.why: Satchel Charge at 20s rank 1 is the whole engage window; Bouncing Bomb at 6s never is.

edits.before: - Ziggs Satchel Charge: matchup-defining — His knockback + self-peel escape. Engage when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Satchel Charge (W): 20s at rank 1 — it knocks you away and launches him clear, so engage inside that window. - Bouncing Bomb (Q): 6s poke from 850. - Hexplosive Minefield (E): a flat 16s slow zone you cannot walk through.

edits.before: Track Ziggs's Satchel Charge: His knockback + self-peel escape. Engage when it's down. When it is down — W-brittle + E knockup.
edits.after: Satchel Charge (W) is 20s at rank 1 — it knocks you back and launches him clear, so E off your pillar once it is spent.

edits.before: His knockback + self-peel escape. Engage when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Satchel Charge is 20s at rank 1 and it launches him clear — engage after it, never before.

edits.before: Ziggs wastes Satchel Charge — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Satchel is spent — 20 seconds with no escape, so commit now.

edits.before: That is Ziggs's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Satchel Charge deals max-health damage — armour stacking does not blunt it.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Short Fuse is an auto reset — his windup is the tell, not the cast.

edits.before: R adds a long-range double knock-up that closes the gap his whole kit exists to keep, so you own the all-in before his AP items.
edits.after: R closes the 2500-range gap his whole kit exists to keep — the pass brittles, the recast knocks up, so you own the 6 all-in.

notes: Ziggs's Satchel Charge displaces Ziggs as well as the target, which is why it is both his escape and his disengage — the old text called it a 'self-peel escape' without ever saying he is launched. Also worth a later pass: Ornn's Q pillar as a body-block against Bouncing Bomb is asserted in several strings, but nothing in either kit file confirms the pillar blocks his projectile; left unchanged and recorded as unverified.
